name: DSH Flash 精简预设
description: Two DSH agent presets tuned for token efficiency on flash-tier routes: PTC tool surface, a 25% compaction threshold and a turn budget. 精简·PTC v3 (lean-v3, flash-lean-ptc-v3) keeps 13 rules (default); 精简·PTC v3 balance (flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance) keeps only the 3 rules the harness cannot enforce.
descriptionZh: 面向 flash 级路由的 token 效率预设，只发两个：精简·PTC v3（lean-v3，flash-lean-ptc-v3，13 条规则，默认）与 精简·PTC v3 balance（flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance，3 条规则）。旧 id 由运行时兼容层解析到 flash-lean-ptc-v3，不改写任何会话文件。
